scenarios.name: Bull – AI Burn-In Standard + SiC Recovery
scenarios.notes: Wafer-level burn-in becomes standard for AI accelerator reliability screening (lead hyperscaler ramps, second AI supplier converts); SiC recovers on 200mm transition and 800V datacenter power; HBM/memory WLBI lands. Revenue ~$500M by FY2031.

scenarios.name: Base – Guide Met, Then Deceleration
scenarios.notes: Revised FY2027 guide ($150M revenue, at least 20% non-GAAP net margin) met on $109.3M effective backlog and a required $39.0M Q2-Q4 quarterly average; AI burn-in grows but stays concentrated in 1-2 hyperscale customers; SiC slow recovery through the 2027-28 correction; growth decelerates to high-teens after FY2027.

scenarios.name: Bear – Backlog Evaporates / Burn-In Intensity Falls
scenarios.notes: Most customer POs are cancellable/reschedulable with limited penalties; backlog slips or the revised $150M FY2027 guide is cut; lead AI customer insources or qualifies a competitor; device yield improvements cut burn-in intensity; negative cash conversion persists; SiC glut persists past 2028. Re-rating to cyclical multiple.

evidence_for: Q1 FY2027 revenue $33.007M (+200% YoY, +75% sequentially); GAAP/non-GAAP gross margin 47.5%/48.5%; GAAP EPS $0.21 and non-GAAP EPS $0.28 [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1, 2026-11-02].
Q1 bookings $46.7M (book-to-bill ~1.4); backlog $100.9M at quarter end and effective backlog $109.3M at 2026-11-01 [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1].
FY2027 guidance raised to $150M revenue with non-GAAP net income at least 20% of revenue, from $130-150M and 18-22% [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1].
Customer diversification improved through FY2026: top customer 67.3% (FY2024) to 26.3% (FY2026); three customers >10% [10-K FY2026 Item 1].

Second AI supplier has decided to purchase a FOX-XP evaluation cell for Taiwan OSAT validation; lead Sonoma customer is shipping/installing >12 systems/month and qualified a second processor [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1].
Cash, equivalents and restricted cash $105.052M at Q1; FY2026 10-K reported no debt [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1; 10-K FY2026 Item 8].
evidence_against: Valuation remains the core constraint: the conservative $0.895 guided-minimum EPS calculation and revised $150M revenue guide do not clear the 12% hurdle at the post-print pipeline price; dated valuation is preserved in the 2026-11-04 decision_journal entry.
Q1 operating cash flow was -$3.054M despite $9.357M non-GAAP net income; receivables and inventory consumed $10.686M and $9.037M of cash [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1].
Q1 customer concentration is undisclosed; 'more than a dozen potential customers' is pipeline commentary, and the second Sonoma processor increases exposure to the same lead hyperscaler.

Most customer POs are cancellable/reschedulable with limited penalties; effective backlog includes post-quarter orders and has no fiscal-quarter delivery schedule [10-K FY2026 Item 1A; Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1].
Q1 stock compensation was $1.880M and shares outstanding rose 0.56% from FYE2026; historical cash was dilution-funded and remaining shelf capacity is unverified.
Structural category risk: customer yield improvements or sampling (vs 100% burn-in) reduce demand [10-K Item 1A].
SiC overcapacity expected to persist until 2027-2028 (Yole via PCIM 2026-07-29); Q1 supplied no quantified SiC, GaN, HBM, or NAND production revenue.
open_questions: Q1 FY2027 10-Q customer/product/geographic concentration, inventory composition, receivables, equity detail, subsequent events, and backlog timing.
Second AI supplier evaluation-cell purchase status, installation/validation timing, production criteria, and high-volume production decision.
Remaining S-3/ATM shelf capacity and post-quarter dilution intent.
Named wafer-level burn-in competitors and whether the 'only vendor offering both' claim holds.
Official audio/caption confirmation of transcript-only consumables, margin, capacity, and market-opportunity claims.
Deceased officer identity and key-person exposure (Sep 2026 proxy).

predictions.notes: Resolved TRUE on review 2026-11-04: Q1 revenue was $33.007M, exceeding the $25M checkpoint by $8.007M / 32.0% [Q1 FY2027 SEC Ex-99.1, 2026-11-02].

predictions.claim: FY2027 revenue (year ending 2027-06-25) lands >= $130M, the guidance low end
predictions.notes: Original prediction preserved against the original $130M low end; Q1 revenue $33.007M and $109.3M effective backlog strengthen it, but guidance is not an actual. The revised $150M guide is tracked separately.

predictions.claim: FY2027 revenue lands >= $150M and non-GAAP net income lands >= $30M
predictions.notes: Registered after the 2026-11-02 guide raise. Q2-Q4 must average $38.998M revenue, 18.1% above Q1; backlog cancellation/rescheduling, delivery timing, concentration, and cash conversion remain risks.

predictions.claim: No single customer exceeds 30% of revenue in the FY2027 10-K
predictions.notes: Top customer was 26.3% in FY2026 with three customers >10%; AI ramp could re-concentrate revenue into the lead hyperscale account.

predictions.claim: The benchmarked 'major supplier of AI accelerators, CPUs, and network processors' places a production (pilot or volume) order by mid-2027
predictions.notes: Remain OPEN after Q1: the customer has decided to purchase one fully configured FOX-XP cell for production-environment evaluation at a Taiwan OSAT, with installation planned early CY2027 and an HVM decision several months after validation. This is not conservatively classed as a production (pilot or volume) order.

decision_journal.situation: AEHR at $80.10 (~$2.61B cap) trades at ~90x guided FY2027 non-GAAP EPS (~$0.85 midpoint) after +245% in 52 weeks. Scenario-weighted 5-year expected CAGR is ~-0.5% from this entry; the market has pre-paid the bull case. Business momentum (backlog 5.3x, AI order cadence, diversification 67%->26% top customer) is genuinely strong.
alternatives_rejected: Initiate a starter position at $80 (rejected: negative scenario-weighted expected return at this entry; Kelly sizing is zero).
Wait for a post-earnings dip mechanically (rejected: no dip may come if Q1 confirms; the entry rule is price-based, not event-timing-based).
Drop coverage as too expensive (rejected: story quality and engine value of a tracked belief state justify watchlist tracking with dated predictions).

decision_journal.situation: Post-Q1 FY2027 review using SEC Exhibit 99.1 and the 2026-11-03 pipeline price of $64.52. Revenue $33.007M cleared the $25M checkpoint; bookings $46.7M, effective backlog $109.3M, GAAP/non-GAAP GM 47.5%/48.5%, and FY2027 guidance moved to $150M with non-GAAP net income at least 20%. Offsets: OCF -$3.054M, undisclosed Q1 concentration, same-customer second Sonoma processor, and only an evaluation-cell decision from the second AI supplier. Probabilities move Bull/Base/Bear 0.25/0.45/0.30 -> 0.25/0.50/0.25; starting EPS override $0.895; CAGRs and exit P/Es unchanged. Engine expectedMultiple 1.3060x and expectedCagr 5.4849%; 12%-hurdle entry $47.81; Kelly zero. Findings: docs/research/tickers/aehr-q1-fy2027-earnings.md (confirm pass 9 groups confirmed, 2 wording revisions).
alternatives_rejected: Upgrade Bull probability or terminal multiples on the guide raise (rejected: second-supplier HVM adoption, realized diversification, durable consumables recurrence, and multi-year growth remain unproven).
Initiate or chase a position after the print (rejected: expected CAGR remains below the 6.5% benchmark and 12% hurdle; Kelly remains zero).
Treat the second supplier's evaluation-cell decision as resolving the production-order prediction (rejected: installation and validation still precede the HVM decision).
